description.text: The third Sun & Moon set, released on 4 August 2017 with 169 cards: 147 and 22 secret rares. It is loosely based on the film I Choose You! and brought the English debut of Charizard-GX, in a standard and a secret rare version, and the first cards of Tapu Fini, Necrozma and Marshadow. Darkrai-GX and Ho-Oh-GX are among its 12 Pokémon-GX, and its full-art Trainers include trial captains and members of Team Skull.
